title: Certify sharp payload storage for selected BIT residuals
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2697 leaves residual and primitive temporaries as an asymptotic term. This contribution proves the sharp live **payload-only** bound `3v + 3R` for its unchanged completed residual engine, including the borrowed input. Here `R` is one complete prefix fibre and `v = P R` is the whole packet.

The proof accounts for overlapping original input, current packet, partial output, local source, intermediate and primitive buckets/output. It also derives the retained-role MOVE/COPY corollary: `664v + 3R` for the source's 661 ordinary roles and possible private role. That corollary is not a total caller reserve.

Only `research/selected-residual-live-volume/` is added: one proof/README, one runnable checker, exact receipt and metadata, and 22 unchanged source exports. No production transform, predecessor source or selected record changes. No new supplier or kappa is claimed.

## Task and overlap

This takes the explicit residual-lifetime handoff in [Discussion2319](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18955184), after the route component in #2708 and directory component in #2688. It does not reconstruct those components.

- Started from canonical main `719105847d558bc5538d7f005e7ca7fcc6201e31`, priority revision 5; fast-forwarded before submission to `b62dcc58a6beecfcae79627042bf9c48d0e71e6f`. Guidance, selection, replay runner and scientific pins are unchanged.
- Exact engine source: #2697 at `a53fdf4bcbe33c6732f0bec1badc8c023380f9d1`.
- Complementary sources: #2708 at `2982489cc00a17bd1c7ee1e206e975eda9bcb64d`; #2688 at `1b9e1ed8793ffdde3c4b115641f0e644a9289923`.
- `TASK.json` records a **changed** scope from the drawn `bit-new-register-model` card to this central BIT implementation obligation. No new operation alphabet is claimed.
- Complete final overlap snapshots cover 764 open PRs including drafts and 1,348 Discussion records, plus local notes/ledger and direct source-head reads. Metadata searches do not prove novelty.

## Validation

Registered CPython 3.12.13 replay and optimized standalone replay pass. The exact receipt contains **17 fixtures, 231 primitive events and 10,701 positive-fixture input cells with individual origin tracking**. Good/fallback traces complete 1 and 19 child returns. A sharp fixture reaches **8,748 cells**; budgets of 6,804 and 7,776 are rejected at the actual measured cut.

Checks include separate modular address expectations, actual Boolean values, source immutability, direct peak censuses, owned-payload cleanup, missing-child-return rejection, source-byte corruption and incomplete manifests. A Git-free optimized export preserves all files; on-disk source corruption, boolean/integer receipt substitution and output overwrite are rejected. All 70 repository research-workflow tests and the README link/structure check pass. A separate read-only Astra/max proof and checker review found no blockers.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-residual-live-volume --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-residual-live-volume
python3.12 -B -O research/selected-residual-live-volume/verify.py
```

The theorem assumes successful complete traces and callbacks that allocate no payload. LEFT markers, directories/fields, numerical/control/count tapes, Python capacity, arbitrary error-path cleanup, larger recursion and total reserve are excluded. The full selected GL64 payload, selected coefficient callbacks and full caller schedule were not dynamically executed here. No full selected cold replay, formal-kernel verification or independent human review is claimed. Hosted CI is separate from these local results.

## Credit

Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml supplies PR2697 and its retained stream, normal-form, controller, selected-word and hosting lineage. Nick Petalas supplies the route result and residual-lifetime handoff; ywz65 supplies the directory and earlier primitive/setup audits. `vendor/NOTICE.md` retains predecessor attribution and the original exports remain byte-exact.

New work is Apache-2.0, prepared by starship-s with substantial Hermes (`gpt-6-astra-900k`) and Codex (`gpt-6-astra`, max effort) assistance.

## Open next questions

Join the residual, route and directory components at their actual simultaneous lifetimes, then add protected/family copies, numerical/control tapes, markers and disposal. A source-matched full-node event ledger is the smallest useful next step. It matters because separate component maxima do not certify total numerical reserve; larger recursive returns remain a separate obligation. See the README and `TASK.json`. This contribution stops at the component result.
